create_prediction_dataset: create a prediction dataset from a ground truth dataset with configurable index range and visualization
add_prediction_to_record: add a prediction to a dataset record by converting input documents to predicted DoclingDocument output
visualize_prediction_results: visualize prediction results by generating comparison HTML with ground truth and predicted documents
get_effective_indices: get effective begin and end indices for processing a subset of dataset items
create_dataset_record_with_prediction: create a dataset record with prediction including predicted document and extracted images
